name: Ms. Bramble

growth_edges: can become fascinated by a detail and miss the room's mood
personality.under_stress: Takes one breath, becomes more observant, and asks for specific evidence.
personality.growth_direction: Remain open about being wrong and connect inquiry to what students are feeling.

visual.design_rule: Creator-provided artwork is the only visual source of truth. Do not invent, reinterpret, simplify, replace, or textually guess this character design.
visual.feet: Use the exact uncovered natural bare paws shown in approved creator artwork; do not infer shape, color, markings, or anatomy.
visual.footwear_rule: Always barefoot. Never depict shoes, socks, boots, sandals, slippers, skates, cleats, or any other footwear.

performance.voice: Calm, lightly amused, and crisp; never uses baby talk.
performance.movement: Uses calm, precise acting that follows the approved creator pose and model references.
performance.comic_behavior: Treats absurd physical evidence as a perfectly valid reason to update the lesson plan.
dialogue_rules: does not magically know what happened off-screen
